items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15 with metadata; all volumes (5, 4, 1 µL, 3×5 µL mix) are handled by the p20 within its 1–20 µL range, the 10 µL reactions fit the wells, and the labware is used as intended.
Every transfer uses its own pick_up_tip and drop_tip inside the loops. The tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks all pass.

The 10 µL reaction (5 µL 2x master mix, 4 µL primer pair, 1 µL template) follows the paper's OT-2 workflow. The Q5 cycling comment (98 °C 30 s; 30 cycles of 98/60/72; 72 °C 2 min; 4 °C hold) and the seal step are recorded, and the citation is accurate.
Master mix goes into each well first, then the primer pair, then 1 µL template. The 5 µL of 2x master mix in a 10 µL total gives 1x.
The code zips primer_wells and colony_wells to pcr_wells (A1→A1 through H12→H12), so all 96 wells are used once each.
Comments record plate sealing and the Q5 program: 98 °C 30 s, 30 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, 60 °C 20 s and 72 °C 30 s, a 72 °C 2 min final extension, and a 4 °C hold.

judge.summary: The protocol builds 10 µL reactions in the order master mix, primer pair, template, with a fresh tip each time. Well mapping is 1:1 across all 96 wells. A Q5 cycling program is recorded as comments, and all the measured checks pass.
